message: ダメ人間たち

name: Synn
message: 「So, have you decided on your exhibit yet?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not at all. I'll think about it again when I get home today.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You guys in the Sweets Club sure are useless, huh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「At this rate, getting promoted to an official club is just a pipe dream.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I already know that!」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, getting promoted to a club is only a possibility depending on how things turn out, you know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well... I guess so. I know that, though.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's up with you, acting all timid today?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's no point acting tough for no reason in front of my childhood friends.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I'm really glad you're participating in the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, but just participating isn't...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even deadwood adds to the scenery, as they say.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I want everyone who takes part to have fun.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Have fun, huh. What would be fun, I wonder.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you think about things related to sweets, that should naturally narrow it down.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A cake buffet would get people hyped, but that's just a rehash of KiraFes... plus, there's the money issue.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not hosted by the academy, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A research presentation probably wouldn't be very exciting either...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wouldn't that depend on how you present it?」

name: Synn
message: 「For example?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Completely naked with whipped crea--」

name: Synn
message: 「Taking it out on Paqy just because you can't think of anything is a bit harsh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh... You really are dense.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so--!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It is!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, how about just creating and unveiling a brand-new kind of sweet yourself!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that a challenge directed at me!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't mean it like that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry. It's just that I can't make them.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're always going on and on about sweets, sweets, sweets, and you can't even make 'em?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up, shut up, shuuut uuuup!」

name: Synn
message: 「You bounced back fast. Still, it really is strange.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If I do say so myself, my palate has gotten way too refined.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What if whatever I make ends up being like a 5 out of 10...」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't everyone like that at first?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe so, but still.」

name: Paqy
message: 「With Synn-sama, no matter what you serve him, he'll just say 'delicious, delicious'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's exactly why that's no good!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm fine eating anything. Especially if it's something you made for me, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「L-Listen here. Just pleasing someone who'd be happy with a sugar cube isn't good enough, right?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that how it works... Even though your soba and stuff are super good.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Soba and sweets are completely different things!! They're not even in the same league!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. My sense of taste is hopeless. Come to think of it, I didn't even appreciate how delicious your soba actually was.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, that's not what I meant... Well, whatever.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I just want you to tell me it's delicious... that it's truly delicious.」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's nothing.」

name: Paqy
message: 「How pathetic.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah, both Misa and Ria-senpai...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't know about Lolo-chan, but all the other girls can make cakes and cookies and stuff, and I'm the only one who...」

name: Synn
message: 「Can't Sacchin not make them either?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh. That's right, that's right!」

name: Synn
message: 「What about Okamoto-san?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She can't! Well hey, I'm totally fine then!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, that just means our Sweets Club is totally hopeless!」
